inputs.label: Ghost Squad Evolution vsg_l folder
inputs.help: The vsg_l folder of your own Ghost Squad Evolution Lindbergh game files. The app runs only the version it was built from.

steps.why: The first start opens the All files access screen.

steps.text: Open Ghost Squad Evolution VR from Library > Unknown Sources. If the All files access screen opens, allow it and start the app again.

notes: lindbergh-recomp-ports releases several games together under one tag, so the asset pattern selects the game; no tag filter is needed while every release carries it. Which game version the app accepts is not stated.
